topic: What interference mitigation techniques are critical for TDMA-based MAC protocols in high-density airport scenarios?
consensus_response: In high-density airport scenarios, multipath, cochannel, multiple access, and mutual interferences reduce transmission integrity. To mitigate these interferences, TDMA-based MAC protocols can employ linear equalizers based on Kalman filtering theory to mitigate multipath interference. Periodic and deterministic scheduling optimize channel utilization, while multiser detection schemes reduce cochannel interference. Furthermore, adaptive frequency hopping (AFH) mitigates Inter-Cell Interference (ICI), and cognitive radio technology (CRT) enables dynamic spectrum allocation, adapting to changing environmental conditions.
